_about: Test notes for the Sunkeeper's effects workbook (tools/gh_testsheet.py). turns: the test hand in play order; an entry with "rest" is a long rest for the whole party. picks: the level-up card picks the hand needs. states: what Gloomhaven shows per animator state, where known; the rest is generated from the pack data.
setup: She needs allies next to her for the buffs and the heals, and an enemy or two adjacent for the smites. Daybreak and Burning Flash infuse Light: watch the element board.

turns.order: Bottom first: move 4 next to an enemy, then the smite (Attack 3, Light infused).
Bottom first: the ranged smite (Attack 5) at an enemy in range, then bless an ally within 3.
turns.setup: An enemy in range, an ally within 3.

turns.order: Bottom first: move 5 and stun an enemy (the ranged smite), then the radial smite on the adjacent ones.
Top: retaliate on herself (the power-up). Bottom: grant an adjacent ally a Move 4.
Top: an adjacent ally recovers a lost card (the targeted buff). Bottom: Loot 1.
turns.setup: An ally adjacent who has lost a card; a coin adjacent.

turns.order: Bottom first: move 2 and bless an ally, then the smite (Attack 4).
turns.setup: An ally and an enemy in reach.

turns.order: Top: the heal (she takes 3 damage for it). Bottom: the radial damage-prevention buff on adjacent allies. Her hand is spent after this turn: Empowering Command is the one card left.

states.MeleeSmite: The hammer smite: an overhead hammer blow with a flash of light, with the melee-smite sound.
states.RangedSmite: A thrown bolt of light at the target with the ranged-smite cast sound.
states.RadialSmite: A ring of light bursts from her over the adjacent hexes, with the radial-smite sound.
states.PositiveBuffTargeted: A beam of light to one ally with the targeted-buff sound.
states.PositiveBuffRadial: A ring of light over the allies around her with the radial-buff sound.
states.ControlAlly: She raises the hammer and the ally glows and acts, with the control-ally sound.
states.PowerUp: The cast pose with her power-up sound.
states.Heal: The cast pose with her heal sound.
states.Loot: Her loot stoop with the loot sound.

actions.expected: Her run cycle with footstep sounds and a dust puff at each footfall.

actions.name: Item use
actions.expected: Her item animation with the item-use sound.
